label: 清晨咖啡馆窗边：低角度暖金晨光 + 白陶瓷杯遮下颌，Soran 三层自然水印

subject.description: an adult East Asian woman with messy natural long black hair, loose strands and wispy flyaways around her forehead and cheeks, their edges catching fine golden-brown rim light
subject.pose: as she sits at a wooden café table, leaning slightly forward, one hand raising a plain white ceramic coffee cup near her mouth so the cup naturally covers part of her mouth and chin, her other hand resting relaxed close to her body, her gaze drifting sideways and downward away from the camera
subject.expression: a quiet, languid, slightly daydreaming expression, as if sitting alone in a café in the early morning
subject.wardrobe: an oversized white shirt draped loosely off one shoulder, revealing her collarbone and a white thin-strap camisole underneath, the fabric soft with natural wrinkles, not neatly arranged

sections.heading: Watermarking
sections.body: a three-layer natural 'Soran' watermark system: first, 'Soran' woven naturally into a tiny fabric label inside the shirt collar or engraved on a tiny pendant; second, 'Soran' hidden within the flow of her hair strands, the wood grain of the table, the reflections on the coffee cup and the folds of the fabric; third, 'Soran' micro-embedded into fiber textures, crossing hair strands, porcelain glaze details and film grain. No external watermark, no sticker-style logo, no floating letters, no captions.

camera.position: at very close distance across the wooden table, at her eye level
camera.framing: subject occupies about 70% of the frame, ultra-close half-body framing cropped at mid-chest

foreground.elements: A blurred drinking glass in the lower-left corner and a small white plate with metal cutlery in the lower-right corner

light.key: Low-angle warm golden morning sunlight slanting through the café window, raking across her forehead, eyes, nose bridge, cheeks, shoulder and collarbone, loose strands casting tiny shadows on her face

background: a street-side café with a blurred city street, buildings and vehicles outside the window, softened by shallow depth of field but still recognizable as a café context
fingerprints: a nearly finished cup of coffee in her hand
a small white plate with metal cutlery on the wooden table
blurred city street life outside the window
atmosphere: a restrained, unhurried early-morning mood, like an unposed slice of life before the day is decided
quality: real photography texture with natural pores and slight facial asymmetry
fine flyaway hair strands and real fabric wrinkles
slight exposure unevenness and natural optical transitions
subtle film grain and natural grain texture
